description: A baseline regression run on main recorded the existing suite passing; a branch then weakens the insufficient-funds check. The agent must select by diff (qast impact), run the mandatory suite, compare against the baseline run, report test_transfer_with_insufficient_funds_is_rejected as a NEW failure (not known/flaky), reproduce it, and gate.
setup: git rev-parse --verify -q HEAD >/dev/null || (git add -A && git -c user.email=qa@example.com -c user.name=qa commit -qm base)
qast run start --mode regression --scope 'baseline: main' --base main
git -c user.email=qa@example.com -c user.name=qa commit -qam 'Move funds validation to the database layer'
